newsitem.title: USA: DataTrend Inc sees profitability in Q4.
newsitem.headline: DataTrend Inc sees profitability in Q4.

text.p: DataTrend Inc said Friday it expects to return to profitability in the fourth quarter.

The company said the new service contracts with AST Research Inc and Compaq Computer Corp began at a slower pace than expected but are now "fully on stream and should favorably" affect results with a return to profitability in the fourth quarter.

For the third quarter ended September 30, the company reported a net loss of $495,427, or $0.11 per share, on sales of $8.99 million. In the prior year's fourth quarter, the company reported net income of $637,355, or $0.14 per share, on sales of $8.93 million.
